input: Huang et al. (2024) observe that earlier self-correction gains (for example Reflexion) came from using oracle labels about answer correctness to decide when to stop correcting, and that the gains vanish without them; in practice such external feedback is often unavailable. Critique a claim that results obtained with oracle labels show how well LLMs self-correct in real use.
source: Huang et al. 2024, Section 1 Introduction (chunks huang2024-002, huang2024-004)
